During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] hired the [[First Sun Mobile Regiment]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization to '''attack''' an [[Unidentified outpost (First Sun Mobile Regiment)|outpost]] somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The outpost had been accused of harboring [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sympathizers. The mercenaries destroyed the settlement; however, as [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] had not had [[Time/Legends|time]] to interrogate the residents, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nile Owen]] ordered that the First Sun regiment be massacred. They were, and only a dozen or so, including [[Matt Talon]], survived.
